messages:
emily-docs: Hey team — I pushed a draft paragraph for SOC2 audit-log retention and an SDK example for redaction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1984. Can legal review the wording around 'retention period' and 'pseudonymization' so we don't accidentally promise more than we can guarantee?

raj-security: on it. Quick skim: we should avoid 'irreversible' wording for pseudonymization. Also call out that export copies may be retained in customer backups — that affects retention guarantees.

noor-legal: thanks Raj. I can reword. Proposal: keep retention ranges (e.g., 90–540 days) and replace any absolutes like 'permanently deleted' with 'deleted from active systems and eligible for overwrite; backups may persist for up to X days'. Is that acceptable?

emily-docs: yes, that helps. For the SDK example I added code that shows .delete_log(event_id). We should add a line that delete_log is a request to mark an event for deletion; actual underlying copies may persist in backups and export artifacts.

noor-legal: exact suggested phrasing: "Data deletion requests will remove items from active audit stores and mark them eligible for overwrites. Copies in immutable backups or customer-managed exports may persist beyond the stated retention window." Feel free to shorten.

raj-security: also flag we have a separate KMS/HSM section — maybe link it in the paragraph about encrypted export. Small nit: change 'pseudonymization' to 'irreversible pseudonymization when applicable' — but only if the process is provably nonreversible. Otherwise use 'tokenization/pseudonymization'.

emily-docs: great. I'll update the PR with Noor's suggested sentence and add the KMS link. For the SDK snippet note, do we want an inline example showing redaction request vs immediate delete? e.g.:

```python
# mark for deletion (async)
client.audit.delete_event(event_id)
# request immediate redaction from export pipeline
client.audit.redact_event(event_id, scope="exports")
```

noor-legal: include that, but label clearly: "redact_event requests may trigger workflows; immediate removal from exported copies cannot be guaranteed for existing third-party backups."

raj-security: add a tiny troubleshooting block: if customers need stronger guarantees, escalate to Dedicated/Private options — they get stricter retention controls and can disable export hooks.

emily-docs: perfect. I'll make three edits: 1) swap absolute wording to Noor's sentence, 2) clarify pseudonymization language per Raj, 3) add SDK comment and link to KMS section. Will ping once pushed. :+1:

docs-bot: PR updated by emily-docs — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1984/files — reviewers: raj-security, noor-legal

emily-docs: updated and pushed. PTAL when you have a moment.

noor-legal: LGTM from legal side after minor punctuation tweak.

raj-security: LGTM but please add the Dedicated/Private note inline (one sentence) so support can triage correctly.

emily-docs: done. Merging in 10m if no objections. Thanks all. :shipit:
